statement.text:
Suppose the prime graph of the finite group G is disconnected. (This means
that the set of prime divisors of the order of G is the disjoint union of non-empty
subsets π and π ′ such that G contains no element of order pq where p ∈ π, q ∈ π ′ .)
Then P. A. Linnell (Proc. London Math. Soc., 47, no. 1 (1983), 83–127) has proved
mod CFSG that there is a decomposition of ZG-modules Z ⊕ ZG = A ⊕ B with A
and B non-projective. Find a proof independent of CFSG.                K. Gruenberg
